title: 30A East Sunshine Shack Seacrest Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Steps from Rosemary Beach* 12,000 Sq. Ft. Lagoon-Style Community Pool – Enjoy access to Seacrest Beach's incredible...
description_expanded: OverviewTop Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Steps from Rosemary Beach* 12,000 Sq. Ft. Lagoon-Style Community Pool – Enjoy access to Seacrest Beach's incredible resort-style pool* Easy Beach Access – Located across 30A from the sugar-white sand with complimentary on-call tram service* Wrap-Around Porches – Relax outdoors with plenty of comfortable seating and a porch swing* Private Landscaped Backyard * Entertainment for the Kids – Xbox 360, toys, games, and a dedicated kids' retreat* Steps to Seacrest Shops and Restaurants – Enjoy dining, shopping, ice cream, and more without getting in the car* Direct Access to 30A Bike Path – Explore the beautiful coastal communities by bike* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. ***Pets are strictly prohibited. Absolutely no pets are permitted in the home.*Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Sunshine Shack, a beautifully decorated three-story retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach! Relax and soak up the coastal lifestyle from the expansive wrap-around porches, unwind in the porch swing, or gather the family for a cookout on the large stainless-steel gas grill. The private, landscaped backyard backs up to a peaceful bike path. After a day at the beach, rinse off in the outdoor hot-and-cold shower featuring a rainwater showerhead. Inside, Sunshine Shack comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with five bedrooms and four bathrooms. The fully stocked kitchen is ready for everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners. Kids will love the third-floor retreat, complete with a twin daybed and trundle and beverage refrigerator. Sleeping arrangements include two King bedrooms, one Queen bedroom, a bunk room with two sets of Twin bunks, a tower bedroom with a Twin daybed and trundle, and a Queen sleeper sofa in the living room. Whether you’re spending the day at the community pool or catching the seasonal tram to the beach, Sunshine Shack offers the perfect home base for an unforgettable Seacrest Beach getaway!The Bed Setup:1st Floor: King Bedroom2nd Floor: King Master Suite2nd Floor: Queen Bedroom 2nd Floor: Bunk Room with 2 Twin Bunk Sets 3rd Floor Tower Bedroom: Twin Daybed + Twin TrundleLiving Room: Queen Sleeper SofaArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
